title: OSPF Adjacency Down — p1 to p2 link passive, LDP labels lost
symptom: p1 logging OSPF adjacency loss with p2 (100.68.0.112). MPLS labels reprogramming frequently. LDP session to p2 dropping.
root_cause: p1 eth2 interface (toward p2) set to OSPF passive — hellos suppressed, adjacency drops
fix_command: delete protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface eth2 passive
